summary: Evogene filed a 6-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 cooperation agreement with the Pure Capital Group (L.I.A. Pure Capital Ltd. and Invest Pro Shukai Hon Ltd.), resolving a board-control dispute. The activists withdraw their September 8, 2026 letter of intent to launch a special tender offer and accept a 60-day standstill; Evogene reciprocates by halting share and convertible issuances, including its ATM, for 60 days. Two activist nominees join the seven-member board immediately, four of seven upon shareholder approval, with three incumbents serving a transition of up to six months. A special general meeting is set for November 10, 2026.
